Ruth (PM): quick sync — can we lock a compact rubric for Design Partner selection? want to maximize signal while keeping ops light.
Ethan (Eng): yes. infra prefers predictable load. fewer high-touch partners is better.
Marisol (ProdOps): ops cap proposal: 6 active DPs max, 2 high-touch. keep 1 slot reserved for rapid follow-ups.
Gabe (Research): prioritize partners who run scripted evals + record sessions. that output is 10x more useful than one-off surveys.
Harper (Design): also care about coverage: aim for 3 different problem spaces per quarter and at least one early-stage startup.
Ruth (PM): draft weights: engage_prob 30%, strategic_value 25%, domain_fit 20%, feedback_depth 15%, compliance_risk 10%. open to tweaks.
Ethan (Eng): compliance should route to "private-deploy" track if needed, not automatic exclusion. intake should capture p95 latency, avg prompt length, concurrency.
Gabe (Research): simple sheet formula (0-1 scoring):
```
score = 0.3*engage + 0.25*strategic + 0.2*domain + 0.15*feedback + 0.1*(1 - risk)
```
Harper (Design): add a soft boolean "infra-exercise" for partners that will test vector DBs, streaming, or tool-calls; use for tie-breaks.
Marisol (ProdOps): operational checks: weekly updates, demo at mid-loop, survey completion >=75%. I'll encode acceptance checks in the intake.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled — will ping 48h before mid-wave and final reviews. :robot_face:
Ruth (PM): DP -> beta promotion gate: >=75% participation, no unresolved infra blockers, and measurable improvement on at least one tracked metric.
Marisol (ProdOps): action: I'll update the intake + automations and share the link.
Gabe (Research): action: I'll draft a scoring sheet with example candidate scores.
Harper (Design): action: I'll map vertical targets and small-team picks.
Ethan (Eng): action: adding infra metadata fields to intake now.
Ruth (PM): i'll consolidate into a 1-pager and post in #product tomorrow. aim for a shortlist by next Tue. :thumbsup:
